integrity.proof_status: Self-contained analytical reduction plus complete finite proof for 40 bounded exceptional structures; standalone exact integer verification.
integrity.scientific_claim: The exact cut-slope criterion with its all-unicyclic classification and a Lipschitz-norm separation example.

scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple undirected unweighted graphs; counting-measure unnormalized Laplacian and real vertex values only.
General cut criterion is exponentially sized. The closed classification is only for connected unicyclic graphs.
External priority remains subject to more extensive historical semigroup and discrete gradient literature checks.
title: Cut certificates for graph-variation heat contractivity and a complete unicyclic classification
